fields.title: How do I place an order?
fields.body: Orders can be placed through your authorized retailer or directly through our brand portal. Contact your account manager for assistance.

fields.title: What is the minimum order quantity?
fields.body: Minimum order quantities vary by product category. Standard pieces typically require 2-3 units, while limited editions may have no minimum.

fields.title: How long does shipping take?
fields.body: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express options are available for urgent orders at additional cost.

fields.title: Can I track my order?
fields.body: Yes, tracking information is provided via email once your order ships. You can also view status in the brand portal.

fields.title: How do I authenticate products?
fields.body: All products include authentication certificates. Use our verification portal or scan the QR code on the certificate.

fields.title: What materials are used?
fields.body: We use only the finest materials: 18K gold, platinum, ethically-sourced diamonds, and premium gemstones.

fields.title: Are products customizable?
fields.body: Many products offer customization options including metal choice, stone size, and engraving. Contact your account manager for details.

fields.title: What is the warranty policy?
fields.body: Products include a 2-year manufacturer warranty covering defects. Extended protection plans are available.

fields.title: How do I access marketing materials?
fields.body: Marketing materials are available in the Resources section of your brand portal. Download high-resolution assets for print and digital use.

fields.title: Can I customize marketing templates?
fields.body: Yes, templates can be customized with your store information. Use the built-in editor or download editable files.

fields.title: What social media assets are available?
fields.body: We provide ready-to-post images, videos, and captions for Instagram, Facebook, and other platforms.

fields.title: How often are marketing materials updated?
fields.body: New materials are released quarterly aligned with seasonal campaigns. Priority updates are pushed for new product launches.

fields.title: How do I reset my password?
fields.body: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email address.

fields.title: How do I add team members?
fields.body: Account administrators can add team members from Settings > Team Management. Each member receives their own login.

fields.title: What are the different user roles?
fields.body: Roles include Admin (full access), Manager (order and content management), and Staff (view only with limited actions).

fields.title: How do I update store information?
fields.body: Store details can be updated in Settings > Store Profile. Changes reflect across the platform within 24 hours.
